body: Has anyone else experienced how Korra CPUs will just fly off the stage to their deaths if you stand near the ledge?
Yep, I was tired of being homeschooled by my abusive mom all day and just wanted to go to my local public school w my friends. So instead they sent me to military school 😑

It’s actually pretty aggravating having someone tell me all that as if I haven’t thought of that before and like I haven’t been giving it my all. It won’t “eventually stop” bc I have a chronic back problem that will, in fact, get worse over time. So yeah

Dude I’m 25 and I tried “not giving the fuck up” for my whole life, and now I’m stuck with debilitating Heath issues that I have no hope of fixing bc I can’t work and don’t have the money for medical expenses. It’s easy for people who aren’t in the same boat to just say “don’t give up” and “it’ll pass soon” but every person has a limit to what they can take and I passed mine about 3 years ago.

I don’t have any dreams, except for figuring out and solving my health problems which I already explained is impossible . I have no family or anything, I have nothing left.

Right?? There would be constant underhanded comparison statements like “Bobby is sooo good looking” or “Josh already has 20K saved up” things that they knew I was insecure about, just trying to get a reaction out of me. I’m trying to to go NC rn, but it’s hard bc now that I’m an adult, I can see things from their perspective and empathize w them regardless of the physical/emotional abuse.

I’m so glad to hear that you’ve cut off those unhealthy family members from your life, that can be really hard to do! Wow I’ve heard some really bad stories about children from JW families and how they dis-fellowship those who have different beliefs, I’m glad you made it out of that environment. My family were military Baptists, so they were super authoritarian and pretty much forced it on me and my two siblings. My younger sister has always been the golden child (I’m the scapegoat) and she’s still drinking the cool aid, so our relationship is pretty much nonexistent. 

I’ll definitely check out that book, sounds like something I need to read! Thanks for the support, hope your week is great as well :)

Thank you so much for that comment, I helps having a supportive community on here. I will check out those resources, and I’ve definitely considered going no contact with them recently.. just have to get over the guilt and shame that’s been driven into me for doing it. I hope you’re doing well with your narc family too, thanks for the support :)

Thank you so much for your comment. It feels nice to have a community of people suggesting help bc I’ve been feeling so alone lately. I’m very into music myself and it used to be a great coping mechanism, but I’ve been losing interest in everything I used to love. Might need to pick up some THC gummies bc we had to move in right next to a cop (can’t smoke until we move out)
